## About Impact Manager (Yorkshire Cricket Foundation)
## Company Overview
The Yorkshire Cricket Foundation (YCF) is the home of community and recreational cricket, putting cricket at the heart of Yorkshire and inspiring people of all ages, abilities and backgrounds to connect with the game.
From the iconic Headingley Stadium to communities across Yorkshire, the YCF creates opportunities, experiences and a positive impact that supports participation, wellbeing and social connection.

## Job Purpose
Reporting to the Head of Business Development, the Impact Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the Yorkshire Cricket Foundation (YCF) can demonstrate the impact of its work to a wide range of stakeholders including staff, trustees, funders and the communities in which the YCF operates.

The Impact Manager will ensure that programmes (e.g. Wicketz, Women & Girls, Disability) are delivering positive change, meeting funding requirements and improving lives through the power of cricket.
As such, you will be responsible for data analysis and using databases to manage both our internal programme data and externally funded programmes, harnessing the power of data and insight to deliver compelling storytelling.
## Key Responsibilities
Impact Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL)
- Design and implement Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) frameworks to track progress against key performance indicators (KPIs) for diverse community programmes.
- Design and implement primary data collection tools and analyse relevant secondary data sources.
- Analyse and interpret data from various sources (surveys, attendance registers, stakeholder interviews).
- Translate evaluation findings into actionable learning that informs organisational strategy, practice and future programme development.
- Collate, verify and store data in line with GDPR and organisational requirements.
Reporting & Storytelling
- Produce, write and present compelling, high-quality impact reports for the Board of Trustees, funders and partners.
- Develop a portfolio of case studies, testimonials and photographic evidence to showcase the human impact of the foundation's work.
- Collaborate with the Marketing team to disseminate impact findings through digital channels and annual reviews.
Strategy & Development
- Work closely with senior leadership to shape and refine the Foundation's strategy based on data insights.
- Identify new areas for research and evaluation to continuously improve programme effectiveness.
Fundraising Support
- Provide data and evidence for funding bids to trusts, foundations and public sector partners to demonstrate a track record of success.
Stakeholder Management
- Build and maintain relationships with external partners, ensuring they are engaged with the impact findings.
- Train delivery staff and coaches on the importance of data collection and how to use evaluation tools.
- Work collaboratively with partners to promote the appropriate sharing and use of information and insights.
Safeguarding
- Demonstrate, at all times, a commitment to safeguarding children and adults.
- Contribute to the implementation of the Yorkshire Cricket Safeguarding policy.
- Report any safeguarding concerns in accordance with Yorkshire Cricket's Safeguarding Report Management Procedure.
- Ensure a safe and enjoyable environment is maintained, at all times, in line with Yorkshire Cricket's Safeguarding Guidance.
Equality, Diversity & Inclusion
- Demonstrate, at all times, a commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion behaviours, decision-making and working practices.
- Advocate the values of dignity, fairness, equality and respect.

## Requirements & Qualifications
* Experience: Proven experience in a monitoring, evaluation, impact measurement or research role, preferably within the charity, sport-for-development, community or public sector.
* Applied Evaluation Practice: Demonstrable experience of designing, collecting and analysing both qualitative and quantitative data in applied settings, with a clear focus on using evidence to support organisational learning, reflection and improvement.
* Data Skills: High proficiency in both quantitative and qualitative data collection, analysis and reporting (MS Excel, CRM systems, survey tools), with a strong understanding of evaluation design methods and the ability to generate robust statistical and impact data that can be used to inform strategic decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, compelling stories for a range of audiences.
* Passion for Sport: A strong understanding of how sports programmes can drive social change, specifically in terms of health, education and social cohesion.

Reporting to the Executive Producer, the Junior Producer acts as a key facilitator ensuring the EP can effectively and efficiently run the AllSaints yearly production slate of shoots and events. This highly efficient role is designed to support the Executive Producer across all campaign and editorial productions, while also working alongside the E-commerce Studio Manager on model bookings.

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
**About the Team:**
AlphaSense Marketing is a revenue focused marketing team that encompasses demand generation, product marketing, corporate communications, PR / AR, brand, customer marketing, content marketing, and experience marketing. At our core, we're here to fuel AlphaSense's growth, which we do by contributing to pipeline and revenue; developing a brand that's widely known to the markets we serve; and encouraging user engagement both within our product and with our brand.
**About the Role:**
The International Marketing team is the glue between regional priorities and the global marketing organisation, working across everything from field events and sponsorships to demand generation and integrated campaigns. The ideal candidate is a hands-on B2B marketer with experience marketing to Financial Services or Corporate audiences who thrives in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.
You will be executing the regional marketing plan with pipeline and bookings as your core measures of success. You’ll work closely with global Marketing teams to regionalise campaigns and build integrated EMEA programs, while partnering with SDR and Sales teams to drive engagement, follow-up and conversion.
#### Setup: Hybrid
#### Location: London
**What You’ll Do:** * Partner with the EMEA sales and SDR teams to ensure alignment of marketing activity with sales priorities and pipeline goals.
* Collaborate with other marketing team members to localize and execute campaigns in region.
* Measure, track and report the effectiveness of activities and provide recommendations for future campaigns/programs/events.
* Execute the EMEA 1:1 ABM programme in close partnership with sales pod leads, running quarterly client engagement against a defined set of focus accounts.
* Deliver EMEA ABM events and touchpoints against existing account plans and playbooks, adapting them as needed for each account.
* Run the team's hosted event cadence, including breakfast briefings and broker-hosted events, as an established, repeatable programme. Own end-to-end planning and execution: venue sourcing, speaker/broker coordination, guest lists, on-the-day delivery, and post-event follow-up with sales.
* Manage AlphaSense's existing third-party sponsorship and partnership relationships, ensuring all contracted benefits are delivered.
* Act as day-to-day point of contact for external partner organisers, coordinating logistics, deliverables, and renewal conversations.
* Maintain accurate budget tracking and reporting for owned programmes.
* Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested.
#### **Who You Are:**
* 2–5 years of experience in demand generation / growth marketing
* Proven experience partnering directly with sales and/or SDR organisations to deliver marketing-sourced pipeline.
* Demonstrated ability to plan, manage, and execute hosted events and client engagements to a high standard.
* Comfortable managing external partner and vendor relationships, including sponsorship logistics and contract deliverables.
* Familiarity with ABM strategies and tools (e.g. Demandbase) in a multi-market context is a plus
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent programmes and stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills - comfortable building reports and translating data into action
* Preferred experience: Google Workspace (GSuite), Salesforce, Marketo, Mutiny, and Tableau.
* London-based, able to work hybrid and attend on-site events as required.
**Why AlphaSense**
* Work with a high-performing, mission-driven team that values innovation and execution and has a lot of fun doing it.
* Step into a well-defined, already-running programme with clear documentation and support.
* Direct exposure to senior sales stakeholders and high-profile client events across EMEA.

Exciting opportunity for an experienced Product Manager, or an aspiring Product Owner ready for the next step, to join a fast-paced high growth PE backed global software provider and help shape the direction of our investigation software within the Product team.
Our Altia
By being a trusted technology partner, we empower the government, public and private sector with actionable intelligence solutions to combat increasingly complex crimes. Specialising in crime reduction, we help make the world a safer place.
Initially based in the UK, Altia has grown significantly in recent years through expansion of international operations. We currently have a team of around 90 employees, supporting a wide variety of clients globally.
Our clients include law enforcement agencies, government departments and agencies, regulatory & tax authorities, and private sector customers – who all trust and rely on our investigation software to help them deliver targeted results. Our solutions significantly save time on investigations and reduce costs in areas such as criminal and civil investigations, fraud and financial investigation, incident and investigation management and a variety of covert fields.
Our experienced team is dedicated to providing our clients with the support and care they need, ensuring they are able to get the most from our ever-evolving specialist investigation software solutions.
The role of Product Manager will be based at our Nottingham office and you will be reporting to the Director of Product. Whilst we operate a hybrid working policy, you will be expected to attend the office on a regular basis following completion of your induction and training.
This is a product role with an unusual design constraint: what we build gets tested in court. Our customers’ work is picked apart by defence teams and inspectorates, which means ours has to stand up too. It is demanding, and it is the best design constraint we know — it makes the thinking sharper, the evidence better, and the product more defensible.
We are looking for a career product person: genuinely close to customers, with the commercial instinct to tell what matters now from what matters next, and the judgement to decide which problem to solve first.
Our business is still growing and now is an exciting time to join our friendly and self-motivated team! At Altia we have a common mission and vision that underpins all that we do. We act with honesty, integrity, and mutual respect towards our customers and one another, working as one team. Our commitment to this is showcased through our achievement of the globally recognised Great Place to Work certification for the second year running. We embrace challenge in order to ensure the most innovative and relevant solutions are developed, always with the end customer in mind.
Please note that the successful candidate will be required to be security vetted. For this reason, you must have been in UK residence for 3 continuous years prior to employment and provide proof of address for the previous 5 years. If you do not fit this criteria and also know that there may be anything hindering you from being vetted successfully, then you will not pass initial screening as security vetting is required by every Altia employee.
The Role
Drafting documentation has never been faster. It still has to be done, done well, and done differently, now that agentic AI sits inside the delivery lifecycle. What has not become easier is the judgement underneath it — knowing which customer problem matters most, what to build first, and what will still matter in three years. That judgement is what this role is for.
You will have exposure across the whole Altia portfolio — case and intelligence management, financial investigation, open-source intelligence, and critical incident management — working closely with the Product Managers and Product Owners already here. Your focus will settle on a defined area of that portfolio, designing capabilities and AI skills around how investigators actually work, finding the differentiators, validating them with the market, and building on the agentic AI work already well underway.
Our customers are law enforcement agencies, regulators, government departments and financial crime teams in the UK and internationally. Because their work is scrutinised, ours has to be defensible. Our approach is human-led and AI-accelerated: everything we build must be capable of being explained, evidenced and stood behind.
This is a dual-horizon role. You will keep the depth needed to make good product decisions alongside delivery teams, while lifting your focus toward market differentiation, customer discovery and commercial impact. You will report to the Director of Product and operate with a high degree of autonomy.
Key Responsibilities:
* Customer discovery and insight. Lead structured discovery — interviews, research, workshops and customer advisory groups — and stay genuinely close to the people who use our software. Define user segments, personas and end-to-end journeys, and identify the moments that matter most.
* Product strategy and roadmap. Shape the long-term vision for your products alongside the Director of Product, own the near-term roadmap, and make and defend prioritisation decisions that balance customer value, commercial impact and delivery feasibility.
* Market intelligence and differentiation. Maintain a current, actionable view of the competitive landscape. Identify whitespace, emerging trends and threats, and translate them into strategic recommendations. Articulate why our products win now and why they will still win in three years.
* Commercial impact. Treat commercial outcomes as a first-class product concern. Understand the levers — upsell potential, churn risk, licence utilisation — and make sure product decisions contribute to revenue growth, retention and expansion of ARR.
* Agentic AI in the product and in the process. Design AI capabilities and skills around real investigative workflows, holding the line on transparency and defensibility. Help evolve our product artefacts and ways of working now that agentic AI sits inside the development lifecycle.
* Go-to-market and positioning. Partner with Sales, Marketing and Altia Solutions on value propositions, positioning, launches, tenders and competitive responses, and contribute to pricing and packaging decisions informed by market and customer insight.
* Product planning and feature design. Lead requirements definition, produce clear and well-scoped user stories with robust acceptance criteria, define MVPs and release candidates, and resolve scope questions quickly during delivery.
* Delivery team collaboration. Keep delivery teams supplied with a well-prepared, clearly prioritised backlog and agreed sprint goals, validate what is built against what was specified, and act as the point of escalation for product decisions during a sprint.
* Product expertise and enablement. Act as an internal authority on your products, resolve complex questions from Sales, Support and customers, and work with Support to turn recurring issues into strategic solutions rather than tactical workarounds.
What you can bring to the role:
* A career in product management, with evidence of owning a roadmap and influencing strategic decisions — or experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst who is ready for the step up.
* Genuine closeness to customers. You seek them out, run your own research, and form your own view rather than relying on second-hand accounts.
* Commercial instinct — a feel for what impacts revenue now and what positions the product for what comes next.
* Judgement under ambiguity. The ability to decide which problem matters most and what to build first, and to explain and defend those decisions to customers, colleagues and the board.
* The confidence to ask the awkward questions early — of customers, of colleagues, and of your own assumptions.
* Comfort working with agentic AI as part of both the product and the process, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it needs a human in the loop, and where it must never be relied on unsupervised.
* The ability to synthesise market data, customer insight and usage analytics into clear, evidence-based strategic narratives.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to influence across commercial, technical and operational teams.
* Experience working in or alongside agile delivery teams, with a clear understanding of backlog management and requirements definition.
* An interest in — or experience of — regulated, evidential or investigative environments where what you build has to withstand external scrutiny; for example policing, law enforcement, regulatory bodies, financial crime, insolvency, defence or national security. Desirable rather than essential: we will teach the domain to the right product person.

Join the Apple Cloud Object Store team as a software engineer to help lead the
development of one of Apple's largest storage platforms — used by hundreds of
internal services at exabyte scale. You'll take ownership of some of the hardest
problems in large-scale distributed storage: from keeping thousands of tenants
fairly and safely sharing the same infrastructure, to improving durability,
performance, and scalability as the platform continues to grow. This is a role
for an engineer who can drive complex, ambiguous technical problems end-to-end

DESCRIPTION
Operating a shared storage platform at exabyte scale means constantly balancing
competing demands: keep the system fast and available for everyone, protect it
from any single tenant's traffic, and keep evolving the architecture without
disrupting the services built on top of it. As a lead engineer on this team,
you'll help set direction across several of these areas, including: Multi-tenant
isolation and fairness. Keeping thousands of tenants safely sharing the same
infrastructure — enforcing quotas, shaping and rate limiting traffic, and
containing the blast radius when one tenant's behavior threatens to degrade
everyone else. Availability and durability at scale. Designing for hardware and
component failure as a constant, not an edge case, while keeping data durable
and available across a massive, distributed fleet. Performance and efficiency.
Finding and eliminating bottlenecks in a complex system, and making sure
optimization effort goes where it has the most impact. Architectural evolution.
Retiring legacy approaches, simplifying fragmented systems, and making
large-scale changes safely in a system that can't afford downtime.

In-depth experience as a backend software engineer with a strong grasp of
computer science fundamentals: networking, filesystems, security concepts.
Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems,
with a strong grasp of concepts like availability, congestion control,
observability, and fault tolerance. Experience driving complex, ambiguous
technical projects end-to-end and collaborating across teams to build consensus.
Experience with at least one of: multi-tenant resource isolation, rate limiting,
or quota systems; large-scale storage systems; or distributed systems
performance/reliability work.

Experience with flow control, overload protection, or admission-control systems
(e.g., adaptive throttling, load shedding, backpressure). Experience with object
storage systems or similar backend storage engines. Experience building
observability/telemetry that makes complex system behavior explainable to

Guidance Navigation and Control - Oxfordshire UK, Didcot (Hybrid)

The successful candidate will play an important role in the design, development, verification and deployment of GNC algorithms and software for our spacecraft systems, working across the full development lifecycle from early concept and algorithm design through simulation, testing, integration and on-orbit operations.
Our mission is to capture and remove uncontrolled space debris, paving the way for innovative technologies that safeguard the long-term sustainability of orbital operations. ## YOUR OPPORTUNITY
**This is a 1-year fixed-term contract opportunity**
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
This high-impact, globally visible role sits at the heart of GTR, shaping performance management and optimising marketing investment to drive commercial outcomes. In this role you will partner with Central Marketing, using performance analysis and insight to support brand, investment and P&L decisions. You will drive visibility and performance of brand investments across GTR, ensuring A&P spend supports our Big Bets and Best10 ambition. You will also lead Central Marketing A&P finance and transactional governance across GTR regions, ensuring strong control, consistency and transparency while Regional Finance Leads retain local ownership. As strategic performance partner to the GTR Finance Director and senior leadership, you will turn financial and commercial insight into decisions that drive sustainable growth, profit and cash.
You will also support regional planning and performance management, shape resource allocation, lead strategic and transformation projects, and influence Finance, Commercial, Marketing and Supply Chain stakeholders across an international matrix.
**RESPONSIBILITIES**
**CENTRAL MARKETING A&P LEADERSHIP & GLOBAL GOVERNANCE**
* Support Central Marketing A&P finance in GTR, while coordinating transactional A&P governance across regions with Regional Finance teams.
* Support end-to-end Central Marketing A&P planning, tracking and performance management, helping ensure spend is optimised against strategic priorities.
* Establish and maintain a consistent global A&P governance framework for budgeting, forecasting, tracking and reporting, in close partnership with Regional Finance Leads.
* Help strengthen financial discipline and accountability across regions, providing constructive challenge to support ROI and value creation.
* Ensure A&P spend is accurate, compliant and aligned with Bacardi policies, including correct coding and accruals.
**MARKETING & BRAND DECISION SUPPORT**
* Partner with the Global Marketing Director and Regional Marketing teams to shape brand strategies and optimise resource allocation.
* Provide forward-looking insights on A&P effectiveness, linking investment decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Support the Measurement & Evaluation (M&E) agenda across GTR, helping embed a data-driven approach to marketing effectiveness.
* Help shape marketing plans by providing financial insight on the balance between brand building and commercial delivery.
* Support development and financial evaluation of innovation pipelines and brand initiatives.
**ENTERPRISE PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & EXECUTIVE INSIGHT**
* Support the consolidated GTR performance management agenda, covering monthly results, forecasts, annual budget, Integrated Activity Planning (IAP) and longer-range financial plans.
* Support landing reviews, business performance reviews and forecast discussions, challenging regional inputs and ensuring clear actions and accountability.
* Translate performance across regions, customers, channels and brands into concise executive narratives that highlight the drivers of NSV, gross profit, EFO, cash and working capital.
* Support GTR risk and opportunity management, using scenarios, sensitivities and external indicators to anticipate volatility and recommend timely interventions.
* Prepare high-quality analysis and presentations for the GTR Leadership Team, AMEA & GTR Finance leadership and global stakeholders.
**STRATEGY, PROJECT LEADERSHIP & TRANSFORMATION**
* Support high-impact, cross-functional projects with measurable commercial and financial outcomes, from problem definition and business case development through implementation and benefits tracking.
* Support the GTR strategic and long-range agenda by combining internal performance, market dynamics, traveller trends, customer developments and competitor insight.
* Support transformation activity, including process redesign, data and reporting improvements, and adoption of new planning and ERP capabilities such as SAP S/4HANA.
* Simplify, standardise and automate planning and reporting while maintaining clear governance over milestones, investment, benefits and risks**.**
**LEADERSHIP, GOVERNANCE & MATRIX INFLUENCE**
* Support the Finance Director in selected performance, planning and project forums when required.
* Ensure consolidated plans, forecasts, reporting and investment decisions are accurate, consistent and transparent, partnering with Regional Finance, Global Performance Management and Bacardi Enterprise Services.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, inclusion and continuous improvement, consistent with Bacardi’s 3Fs: Fearless, Family and Founder.
**SKILLS**
* **Experience and qualifications:** 5-7 years of experience in commercial finance, FP&A, performance management or strategy within an international matrix organisation. FMCG or consumer-sector experience and a recognised professional finance qualification are preferred.
* **Finance and commercial expertise:** Strong command of P&L performance, forecasting, planning, risk and opportunity management, investment appraisal and scenario modelling, with the ability to connect results to market and customer drivers.
* **Strategic and project leadership:** Ability to frame complex questions, convert ambiguity into clear recommendations and lead cross-functional initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* **Stakeholder influence and communication:** A track record of building trusted relationships, challenging constructively and communicating complex topics concisely to executive audiences across functions and geographies.
* **Systems:** Advanced Excel and modelling capability; Power BI, TM1 or SAP experience is advantageous. Fluent English is required.

* **Belonging:** You create an environment where people feel appreciated for who they are, what they do and who they can become.
* **Self-Awareness:** You understand your strengths, development areas and impact on others, and actively seek feedback to grow.
* **People Agility:** You build meaningful relationships, navigate challenging situations and multiply collective performance across diverse teams.
* **Results Agility:** You deliver in new and ambiguous situations, creating confidence, focus and accountability around outcomes.
* **Mental Agility:** You think critically, make fresh connections and balance strategic perspective with disciplined execution.
* **Change Agility:** You bring curiosity, resilience and a growth mindset, experimenting thoughtfully and applying learning quickly.

Job Title
Senior Data Governance Analyst - 13 month Fixed term contract
Department
Data Services-BG-UK
Overview of Department
Purpose of Role
The Senior Data Governance Analyst helps shape how trusted data is governed and used across Baillie Gifford. You will take ownership of one or more core Data Governance areas: - Governance by Design, Data Products & Technology Enablement - Federated Ownership, Data Quality & Adoption - Enterprise Governance, Risk & Assurance You will lead colleagues within your sub-team, strengthen data ownership and quality, and embed practical governance across Data Products, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled change. Substantial Data Governance experience, sound judgement and stakeholder influence are essential.
Responsibilities
Portfolio Leadership and Delivery Lead one or more core Data Governance areas, setting priorities, maintaining a roadmap and tracking risks, dependencies and outcomes.
Lead governance work from problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating business and technology colleagues. Build trusted stakeholder relationships, make proportionate recommendations and escalate material issues early. Governance Framework and Embedded Delivery Develop and embed practical governance policies, standards and controls, translating them into procedures and decision routes teams can apply consistently. Embed governance requirements in Data Products, change initiatives, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including input to data models and integrations. Shape governance tooling and automation where processes and accountabilities are clear. Data Quality, Ownership and Assurance Strengthen Data Owner and Data Steward accountability, supporting decisions on definitions, quality, access and remediation. Define scalable data-quality rules and thresholds, lead complex investigations and agree proportionate fixes with accountable owners. Produce reporting and assurance evidence showing whether governance is working and where action is required. Leadership and Continuous Improvement Lead your sub-team to deliver agreed priorities, review work quality and build capability through coaching and meaningful ownership. Maintain repeatable methods, clear documentation and effective cross-cover, using management information and feedback to improve outcomes. What Success Looks Like Clear ownership and delivery across your Data Governance area, with predictable engagement routes, prioritised outcomes and useful measures. Governance that is easier to apply, with practical standards and timely support reducing uncertainty, rework and avoidable escalation. Improved ownership and trust in priority data, with visible quality rules, issues, decisions and remediation. A resilient, capable sub-team with reusable methods, strong documentation and effective cross-cover. Your Knowledge and Experience Substantial hands-on Data Governance experience, with expert knowledge of governance frameworks and developing and applying policies, standards and controls. Strong knowledge of data ownership, data quality, metadata and lineage. Practical understanding of data models, databases, integrations, reporting and the data lifecycle. Experience with governance, metadata or data-quality tooling such as Informatica, Collibra, Talend Data Fabric or equivalent. Understanding of Data Products and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, including how governance is embedded across their lifecycle. Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and their application to Data Governance and Data Management. Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives, with strong planning and delivery-management skills. Able to investigate issues across multiple data sources or systems, define quality rules and thresholds, and drive resolution. Experience creating reporting, controls or assurance evidence to support decision-making. Able to manage competing priorities effectively. Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences. Experience influencing governance adoption and helping stakeholders embed new ways of working. Confident influencing senior stakeholders and explaining complex requirements in practical language. Experience leading and mentoring colleagues, reviewing work and establishing repeatable methods. CDMP certification or another recognised Data Management or Data Governance qualification (Preferred) Analytics or AI Data Governance experience. (Preferred) Restricted or licensed data controls. (Preferred) The type of candidate that we’re looking for: You’ll be an experienced Data Governance professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach. You’ll be comfortable working across business and technology teams, turning governance requirements into clear, workable solutions and helping stakeholders embed good data practices. You’ll also be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior colleagues and driving improvements across data quality, ownership, metadata and controls. Critical Skills Data Literacy Nurture relationships Adaptability Digital effectiveness Improvement mindset Systems thinking Closing Date
September 19, 2026

## **Job Description**
Fusion energy offers the potential for significant quantities of low-carbon, inherently safe, abundantly fuelled baseload energy, supporting sustainable climate action and energy independence. While the technical challenge remains high, confidence is increasing, and the rewards of realising fusion are almost incalculable. Anticipated to come online for commercial purposes in the middle of this century, fusion offers a viable means to sustainable net zero in the UK and globally, as well as to increased energy security. The UK is currently a world leader in fusion research and development and in the drive to realise commercially viable energy from fusion, a sector with an estimated value of £tns per year.
STEP (Spherical Tokamak for Energy Production) is the UK’s flagship national programme to deliver a prototype fusion energy plant, targeting 2040, and a path to the commercial viability of fusion. The magnets confining the plasma form the heart of the tokamak device. They are one of the biggest engineering challenges and their design is intimately linked with the plasma performance, overall plant size and maintenance strategy. STEP plans to exploit jointed REBCO magnets to provide the confining field required while allowing access to maintain the machine. This will require some of the biggest HTS magnets yet.

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!
**Role Purpose**
Over the past five years, sand‐related deferrals have routinely exceeded 2 mboed net (~1.3 mmboe/yr) equivalent to ~$80MM/yr at $60/bbl. This excludes the additional opex and capex required to restore well capacity, often resulting in paying twice for the same reserves and consuming rig time that could otherwise be directed toward new wells.
With lower oil prices and increasing development complexity, improving production reliability, capital efficiency, and simplicity becomes even more critical. In several operating regions (e.g., North Sea, Deepwater GoM, Asia Pacific), as well as for water injectors, the range of viable mechanical sand‐control options is often limited to lower cost solutions like Standalone Screens or Cased and Perforated, which increases the need for higher‐confidence sand prediction and assurance, particularly in environments that fall outside our historical operating experience.
As a greater share of production comes from complex, sand‐prone reservoirs, and as well costs continue to rise, bp requires an integrated sand management strategy that can detect, mitigate, and remediate sanding risks early. Strengthening sand management in operated assets also enhances our influence in NOJV and JV partnerships, which represent a material portion of our capital and production delivery.
The Sand Management Senior Petroleum Engineer plays a critical role by providing deep technical insight, integrating surveillance and modeling, shaping safe operating envelopes, and driving reliability across the four chokes (reservoir, well, facility, export). The role establishes standards and best practices, represents bp in partner and industry engagements, and leads capability‐building initiatives to elevate technical excellence across the organization.
**About the Team**
Global Subsurface Solutions (GSS) leverages global experience to deliver prioritized, fit-for-purpose products and unbiased technical support to regional businesses. The Sand Management Central Team plays a critical role in safeguarding asset integrity, optimizing production, and embedding proactive sand management practices across bp’s global portfolio.

* Provide technical guidance on sanding challenges, integrating surveillance data, predictive modeling, and mitigation strategies.

* Develop and maintain global standards, processes, and guidelines for sand management.
* Lead capability-building initiatives, including training programs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and mentoring to uplift sand management competencies globally.
* Collaborate with multi-discipline teams (completions, interventions, flow assurance, erosion-corrosion, operations, and subsurface) to embed proactive sand management strategies.
* Ensure integration of sand management practices across the four chokes – reservoir, well, facility, and export – to deliver holistic sand management solutions.
* Drive technology innovation and adoption, including digital tools and AI/ML applications for predictive sand management.
* Represent bp in partner discussions, joint ventures, and industry forums to promote technical leadership and collaboration.
* Document lessons learned, case studies, and best practices to continuously improve sand management delivery.
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree or equivalent in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Experience in sand management, well integrity, and production optimization within oil and gas operations.
* Strong technical expertise in surveillance integration, predictive modeling, and sand control strategies.
* Proven ability to influence global standards and collaborate across multi-discipline and multi-region teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including external representation.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with advanced sand modeling tools and predictive analytics platforms.
* Experience in industry forums, technical committees, and joint venture engagements.
* Demonstrated leadership in capability-building and technical assurance roles.
**Skills**
* Technical assurance and standardization
* Predictive modeling and surveillance integration
* Stakeholder engagement and external representation
* Training and capability development
* Continuous improvement and technology adoption
* Curiosity, coachability and courage

Up to 10% global travel may be required for partner engagements, industry forums, and regional capability-building initiatives.

London, England
**We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. You will, too.**
Capstone Investment Advisors, LLC (“Capstone”) is a global asset manager, dedicated to exploring alpha opportunities in derivatives and complementary strategies that persist across market cycles. With approximately $12.5 billion of AUM (as of May 1, 2026) and 306 employees, Capstone is headquartered in New York with offices in London, Amsterdam, Stamford, Los Angeles, Boston, Tokyo, Milan, Texas, and Maryland. Since 2004, through strategic insight, market-leading expertise, and advanced technology, we have sought to anticipate and harness the complexities of world markets, creating unique opportunities for our clients, team, and industry.
With our sophisticated, global client base, we recognize that our success is deeply connected to real people. For that reason, we take a human approach to everything we do, focusing largely on collaborative performance. Our workflow and process are built around the belief that by sharing ideas, we achieve greater outcomes. This gives you greater access to resources, direct exposure to senior leadership, and new opportunities to experiment and innovate.
**The Team:**
Capstone is looking to appoint a Senior Risk Engineer at Senior Vice President level within Risk Technology. This is a hands-on role combining software engineering, risk and financial markets, with direct exposure to the investment process. You will design and build investment-facing risk and decision-support capabilities, remaining close to the code, data and users from initial problem through to production.
This is an opportunity to build the technology behind Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy - turning complex risk and portfolio data into timely, actionable intelligence. You will develop tools that help Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider across stress scenarios, risk factors, margin, liquidity and portfolio analytics. The work will directly support sizing, trade expression, hedging, portfolio construction and capital allocation - helping drive better decisions, more efficient capital and more repeatable alpha.
You will work closely with Risk Managers, Portfolio Managers, Quant Research and the wider Technology, Data and AI teams. The role requires deep technical contribution, end-to-end ownership and the ability to shape outcomes through strong judgement, delivery and collaboration. It offers broad exposure across strategies and asset classes, together with the opportunity to help shape the next generation of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform.
We are building a high-performing team that values ownership, collaboration and solving difficult problems. We encourage curiosity and new ideas, alongside the discipline and reliability needed to deliver and support critical production systems.
**Responsibilities and Impact:**
* Architect, build and own production-grade components of Capstone’s Risk Technology platform, remaining close to the code, data and users and designing for performance, scalability, reliability and usability.
* Build and evolve scalable cross-asset risk capabilities spanning Greeks and sensitivities, stress scenarios, VaR, P&L vectors and attribution, limits, factor analytics, margin, and exposure aggregation.
* Partner directly with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Quant Research to solve complex derivatives, risk and portfolio challenges, taking ideas from problem definition through to production.
* Build APIs, data pipelines and interactive decision tools that help users understand what changed, what drove it and what action to consider at trade, POD, strategy and fund level.
* Translate pricing and risk methodologies into scalable, explainable services, with clear treatment of model assumptions, calibration, validation and controls.
* Advance Capstone’s Risk Intelligence strategy by building tools that turn research, risk analytics and AI into practical investment insight - helping Portfolio Managers and Risk Managers analyse scenarios, understand book and factor exposures, diagnose P&L and access validated analytics through natural language.
* Engineer and operate resilient risk services, integrating positions, market and reference data, and internal or third-party analytics, with strong testing, data lineage and end-to-end ownership of production issues.
* Shape and deliver high-value components of the Risk Technology roadmap in partnership with Technology, Data and AI teams, using common platforms, standards and engineering practices and contributing to design reviews, code reviews and knowledge sharing.
**Our future colleague has these skills:**
* 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, quantitative development or risk technology within a hedge fund, asset manager, investment bank or comparable capital-markets environment, with meaningful exposure to front-office or market-risk systems.
* A strong record of personally designing, building and supporting production-grade risk, pricing or trading systems, and owning complex projects from definition through delivery and support.
* Advanced Python / Java and SQL skills, together with strong proficiency in at least one comparable language; practical experience with APIs, distributed or event-driven architectures, databases, data pipelines and large-scale processing.
* Strong understanding of derivatives and cross-asset risk analytics, including option pricing, Greeks, scenario analysis and VaR. Knowledge of factor risk and margin analytics is desirable.
* Strong architecture and engineering judgement, with a focus on maintainability, testability, performance, controls and operational resilience.
* Ability to critically assess model outputs, challenge assumptions and trace discrepancies across data, calibration, methodology and implementation, while explaining conclusions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience integrating internally developed and third-party pricing and risk libraries across asset classes, with strong attention to data lineage, reconciliation, consistency and controls.
* Clear, concise communication and evidence of technical leadership through judgement, ownership, and delivery, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers, Quant Research and engineering teams.
**Bonus skills:**
* Hands-on experience applying machine learning, large language models agentic tools or AI-assisted development in a controlled production environment, including evaluation, access controls, monitoring and human oversight.
* Experience designing and operating modern engineering and data platforms, including cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, streaming, data lineage and observability.
* Deep product and risk knowledge in at least one asset class, combined with a broad working understanding across multiple asset classes, including equities, fixed income, credit, commodities and FX.
**Benefits & Compensation Information:**
Our team is our most important asset and investment. We value and respect our colleagues and their well-being inside and outside the workplace and our culture reflects this. We offer a robust and competitive benefits program to ensure the well-being of our colleagues.
Some benefits included in this role are:
* Training and development opportunities
* Robust Wellness Resources: Physical, Mental and Financial
* Time-Off, Retirement and Commuter Benefits
* Gym Reimbursement and other Discounts

**The team..**
The Group Controllership and Reporting function sits at the heart of ITV’s global corporate finance operations. We are responsible for maintaining overall accounting integrity, delivering robust period-end group consolidations, and ensuring absolute financial accuracy across our international entities. Operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, our team partners closely with Group Tax, Group Treasury, Group FP&A, and global subsidiaries to navigate major strategic transactions, streamline system configurations, and deliver high-quality statutory reporting under IFRS.
**The role..**
We’re looking for a highly experienced Interim Head of Consolidation and Reporting to join our team on a 12-month fixed-term contract basis. Reporting directly to the Interim Global Head of Reporting, you will play a pivotal role in the company’s financial operations throughout a period of significant strategic change, specifically following the announced separation of the M&E division. This position provides essential temporary cover, backfilling the BAU activities of permanent team members who have been seconded to transaction-related projects.
In this high-visibility leadership position, you will manage, coach, and mentor a team of Group Financial Accountants based in Manchester. You will take full ownership of the Group consolidation process via Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud (FCCS), ensure complex acquisitions, disposals, and one-off corporate transactions are accurately accounted for, and manage global subsidiary relationships.
Some of your key day-to-day responsibilities will include:
* Leading the monthly Group consolidation process in FCCS, including preparing supporting schedules and gathering balance sheet analytical commentary on working capital movements across the Group.
* Line managing, coaching, and mentoring the consolidation team of Group Financial Accountants to foster their professional growth.
* Accounting for complex acquisitions, disposals, and one-off corporate transactions in the system to ensure financial accounts accurately reflect structural changes.
* Assist with delivering the Group’s Annual Report accurately and on time across Year End and Half Year reporting periods.
* Managing relationships with ITV subsidiaries globally, serving as a key point of contact and guiding international teams on group reporting requirements.
* Managing and delivering training on the FCCS consolidation system for new finance team members.
* Preparing timely forecasts, budgets, and 5-year plans for relevant Group reporting areas.
* Maintaining strong working relationships with key internal stakeholder groups, including Group Tax, Group Treasury, and Group FP&A.
* Driving process and system improvements across the consolidation and reporting framework.
**Skills you’ll need** (minimum criteria)
* Must be a fully qualified accountant (ACA or ACCA) with extensive Post-Qualification Experience (PQE).
* Hands-on experience using the Oracle FCCS consolidation system.
* Proven background in multi-currency group consolidations for large corporate entities.
* Experience accounting for complex corporate transactions alongside a strong, expert working knowledge of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
* Proven experience line managing, coaching, and developing a team of finance professionals.

Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

Ownership: Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production.
Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas.
Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.
We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.
Nice to Have

Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
Integrations with external business systems.
Kafka or other streaming technologies.
Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.
Why Join Us?
You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe.

As a **CRE Sustainability Project Manager**, you will play a key role in helping DHL Group achieve its sustainability and decarbonization ambitions across one of the world's largest real estate portfolios.

Corporate Real Estate has a responsibility to provide a Building Decarbonization Framework (formerly CNB) that enables delivery of commitments. * Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of DHL's global Building Decarbonization Framework ensuring alignment with DHL Group and divisional requirements. The framework defines an internal global standard for decarbonization & energy efficiency that is adopted by all divisions
* Conduct market research and analysis of constantly evolving policies and legislation to ensure framework is relevant and compliant
* Assess new technologies and solutions that can improve energy efficiency and reduce carbon emissions across DHL facilities worldwide.
* Drive process improvements to enable quicker and more accurate evaluation of technologies for greater deployment across the Group
* Engage and upskill regional and country teams on the Building Decarbonization Framework, providing technical guidance and support in issue resolution
* Maintain user guides and documents published and available to all Divisions, including supporting and contributing to training sessions

* Completing, with minimal supervision, a certain number of assigned desktop CNB assessments
* Identification of process improvements and upskilling country colleagues

* Degree in Sustainability, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Management, Construction, Finance or a related field.
* 3+ years of professional experience in sustainability, strategy development, renewable energy, building engineering, real estate sustainability, or a related area.
* Strong interest in building decarbonization, solar PV, energy efficiency, and low-carbon technologies.
* Experience managing projects and working with multiple stakeholders in an international environment.
* Good understanding of sustainability principles, energy management, and climate-related challenges.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical and business data.
* Confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a global and virtual environment.
* Passion for sustainability and driving meaningful environmental impact.
**We offer:**
* Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world.
* International and virtual environment.
* Flexibility and great opportunity to learn.
* Tempting compensation and benefits.

As an Associate Solutions Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in combining technical expertise with strong sales acumen to identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities across a defined portfolio of customer and partner accounts.

The Senior Level Semiconductor High Voltage LNDMOS (Laterally Diffused N-type Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor) Device Engineer at Diodes, Inc. plays a pivotal role in the design, development, and optimization of high voltage power semiconductor devices. This specialist is responsible for advancing LNDMOS technology to enable reliable, efficient, and high-performance solutions for applications ranging from automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics to renewable energy systems. Bridging the gap between theoretical device physics and practical manufacturing, the LNDMOS Device Engineer ensures the delivery of robust products that meet stringent industry standards. This device engineer will be part of the Diodes, Inc. worldwide technology development organization and will work with a team of industry experts designing and developing analog semiconductor process technologies for Diodes products for both internal and external production. * Process Integration: Collaborate closely with process engineers to define and refine process flows for LNDMOS device fabrication. Evaluate and select suitable materials, doping profiles, and process steps to achieve desired device specifications, manufacturability, and yield.

Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. * New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

Who you are
You own outcomes, not tasks. You can take an ambiguous, open-ended quality problem for a whole system and prioritise ruthlessly between risk, speed, and coverage without waiting to be told how.
You make testing everyone's job, not yours alone. You'd rather pair with an engineer on a risky test and make sure the right coverage exists than write it all yourself.

You judge yourself on stability, escapes, and time-to-detect and never on test counts or coverage percentage. Those are diagnostics you use, not targets you chase.

## About Duvo
Before Duvo, our founders built and ran a $2 billion retailer. They saw how much critical work still depended on spreadsheets, inboxes, supplier portals and the memory of experienced operators. The real process rarely lived in one system. People held the last mile together.
Duvo is building the Enterprise Execution OS: the shared layer that understands how work really runs, carries it across existing systems and measures the business result.
Our agents do the work, not just suggest the next step. They gather evidence, make decisions within agreed rules, route exceptions to the right person and update the source system. People keep control wherever judgment or approval is needed. Every action leaves an audit trail.
We start with one recurring process and a clear outcome. Every solution carries a contracted 5x ROI guarantee.
## The role
As a Senior Transformation Strategist, you will own the customer's business transformation, not a single Duvo deployment.
You will lead a small portfolio of large enterprise customers. Your job is to set the transformation direction, earn the confidence of senior customer leaders and make the calls that keep the work moving. You are accountable for the business result, the customer relationship and the next wave of value.
You will work alongside Transformation Strategists, who own the day-to-day account presence and workstream execution, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who own the technical solution. Your role is to give both teams a sharp steer, raise the quality of the work and intervene when a decision, relationship or commercial outcome needs senior judgment.
This role needs two kinds of experience that rarely come together: the problem-solving discipline of a strong MBB consultant and the judgment of an operator who has had to live with the result.
## What you will own
### 1. Set the transformation thesis
Start with a view, not a blank page. Learn how the work actually happens, including the exceptions and handoffs that never reach a system of record. Test where the loss sits and focus the customer on the few changes that can take out cost, release cash, protect service, shorten cycle time or strengthen control.
Turn that diagnosis into a clear roadmap: what starts now, what waits, what should not be done, who owns each decision and what evidence could change the plan. Set the few questions and decisions that matter, then direct the team to build the fact base and customer materials needed to answer them.
### 2. Lead the account, not every task
Agree which steps should disappear, which decisions an agent can make, which controls must remain and where people need to stay involved. Establish the account cadence: the right senior forums, clear workstream ownership, decisions, risks and escalation routes. Coach the Transformation Strategist who is present in the account day to day; do not become their substitute.
The technical deployment is only part of the job. You will build the sponsor coalition, handle resistance, fix gaps in ownership and capacity, redesign roles and close the old path. You will review the work closely enough to maintain quality and unblock it, while giving the delivery team room to own it.
### 3. Prove the result and open the next wave
Lock the baseline, target and measurement window before implementation. Track misses as well as successes. Put the result into language a CFO would trust, then get the customer to sign it off.
Once the value is proven, shape the next phase. You own the evidence, strategic case and customer readiness; the commercial owner leads pricing and contracting. Identify expansion opportunities early and convert credible delivery into a larger mandate without compromising the current work.
Your unit of ownership is a business result the customer can sustain. It is not a deck, a deployment, a steering committee or a positive user survey.
## Who we are looking for
You should have both MBB training and real operating experience. We will assess five things:
* **Structured problem solving.** You worked in a core, client-facing role at McKinsey, BCG or Bain. You can take an unfamiliar operation apart, find the critical question and give an executive a clear answer without hiding behind a framework.
* **Operating ownership.** You have built, launched, fixed or grown something inside a company, business unit or startup. The result depended on you after the recommendation was made. Strong evidence includes owning a P&L or revenue target, building a new function or taking a product or operating process from zero to real use.
* **Transformation delivery.** You have personally carried a change from business case through implementation and adoption to a measured outcome. You can explain the baseline, the financial logic, who resisted, what you changed and whether it still worked six months later.
* **Executive and commercial judgment.** You can hold your own with a COO, CFO or board. You know when to challenge, escalate, narrow the scope or stop. You have helped turn a successful first engagement into a larger mandate without losing the trust of the customer.
* **Early-stage working style.** You move without perfect instructions, write clearly and surface bad news early. You use AI seriously in your own work and can reason about the split between agents, people, controls and exceptions. You are choosing Duvo for the work, stage and ownership, not for an AI title.
Experience in retail, CPG, supply chain, logistics, inventory or finance operations will help you ramp faster. It is useful, but it does not replace the five capabilities above.
## What good looks like after 12 months
* You independently own a small set of strategic accounts and can state the financial thesis, stakeholder map, workstream health and next decision for each without opening a deck.
* Each account has a Transformation Strategist with clear day-to-day ownership, a useful senior cadence and fast escalation when judgment is needed.
* Customers can point to verified movement in cost, cash, service, cycle time or control. The old process is closed, or has a committed closure date.
* Proven results have led to credible expansion across functions, business units or markets.
* Your work has improved Duvo's playbook. The next Strategist can reuse your diagnostics, proof methods and adoption mechanisms.
## This role is not for you if
* Your best work ended with the recommendation or target operating model.
* You need a mature playbook, a large support team or stable priorities to perform well.
* You describe impact through workshops, launches, training attendance, estimated hours or stakeholder sentiment rather than business results.
* You want to be the sole hero on every workstream, or cannot delegate meaningful execution while retaining accountability.
* You avoid commercial conversations, direct feedback or visible accountability.
## How we work
* **Own it.** The bar is not “I flagged it.” It is “I moved it forward.” An 80% fix today often beats a perfect answer next week.
* **Stay close to the customer.** Know their real day better than the process document. If they ask us to automate something broken, show them a better way.
* **Prove it and say it straight.** Measure before you propose. Share bad news when you have it. Strong opinions are welcome; defending them after the evidence changes is not.
* **Use AI and work in public.** We use AI on our own work and remain responsible for the output. We write things down in English so someone who missed the meeting can still follow.
* **Bring intensity and judgment.** A good answer can still lose if it arrives too late. The pace is high because the team is small and the customer work is live. Commitment comes from the work, not monitoring or guilt.
## Location and travel
This role is remote across the UK and Europe. Expect regular travel and working on site with customers for multiple days in a week when projects are live.
## What we offer
* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity, with flexibility in the balance between cash and ownership.
* Direct access to founders, customers and decisions.
* The budget and autonomy to use the best AI tools available.
* A product already producing measured results in live enterprise operations.
* The chance to help define how Duvo, and its customers, approach AI-led transformation.
## How we hire
1. **Competency interview.** A detailed look at transformations you personally led and the results you produced.
2. **Live case.** An enterprise problem that tests structure, numbers, prioritisation and executive communication.
3. **Founder conversation.** A candid discussion about the role, Duvo and whether this is the environment for you.
We move quickly and give direct feedback throughout.

# Compliance and Standards Officer
**About Elder** Elder is a UK live-in and visiting care introductory agency. We match self-employed carers with older people so they can stay in their own homes rather than move into residential care. Around 500 families use Elder at any one time, and about 14,000 days of care are arranged through the platform every month.
Elder is an introductory agency rather than a regulated care provider. Carers are self-employed and contract directly with the customer. We run vetting, facilitate matching and support both sides.
**The role**
Safety and Trust makes sure the carers we introduce are properly checked, that our standards are applied consistently, and that concerns reach the right person quickly. The team is currently made up of registered nurses, and part of what it handles is clinical work that stays with them.
The rest is a different profession. Compliance administration, standards casework and assurance reporting are their own discipline, and that is what this role is for. You will run our carer compliance operation end to end, own standards casework, and produce the reporting the team runs on.
You will be the only non-clinical person in the team, which means real autonomy. You will report to the Head of Safety and Trust, who has a regulatory compliance background.
**What you will do**
Carer compliance
• Own DBS and PVG orders and renewals end to end, staying ahead of the two-year re-check cycle.
• Check and record right to work, proof of identity, power of attorney, insurance and training certificates, and chase what is missing or expiring.
• Keep the compliance record permanently audit-ready. Handle day-to-day training access and system queries.
Standards and first-line casework
• Run carer standards cases from start to finish, including those raised when a carer leaves a placement early.
• First line on satisfaction feedback, care profile reviews and carer queries, escalating against agreed triggers.
• Establish the facts, apply the framework, record the outcome, and escalate what meets the criteria.
Reporting and assurance
• Produce the weekly pack: volumes, service-level performance, escalation rates and outstanding compliance items.
• Run a monthly consistency check on a sample of closed cases.
• Flag where recurring admin could be automated, templated or made self-serve, and make the case with queue data.
**What this role is not**
• You will not make clinical judgements or form a view on anyone’s condition. Eligibility criteria are set centrally and applied by our system; anything outside them goes to a clinician.
• You will not carry out needs assessments or care planning. As an introductory agency, Elder does not do these things.
• Safeguarding decisions sit with our Designated Safeguarding Lead.
**What you will bring**
Essential
• Two to four years in a compliance or vetting role: pre-engagement checks, document verification, right to work, DBS or
equivalent, renewal cycles.
• Experience working a case queue to a service-level agreement in a CRM or ticketing system.
• Accuracy under volume, and a record you can evidence to an auditor.
• Level 3 safeguarding adults, or a commitment to complete it within three months of joining.
• Working knowledge of the Care Act 2014 and how a concern reaches a local authority.
• The judgement to escalate rather than improvise when a case falls outside the written rule.
• Clear written English, discretion with sensitive personal information, and a working grasp of UK GDPR.
**Desirable**
• Recruitment or staffing compliance, vetting and right to work at volume.
• Care, health or another regulated sector.
• Local authority or NHS safeguarding business support or screening.
• Reporting tools such as Looker.
**Not required**

# Scientist, Advanced Genome Technologies - Plant Biology Institute
**On-site**Plant Biology InstituteFull time
Oxford, England, United Kingdom
## Description
**Join us at EIT:**
At the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT), we're on a mission to translate scientific discovery into real world impact. We bring together visionary scientists, technologists, engineers, researchers, educators and innovators to tackle humanity's greatest challenges in four transformative areas:
* Health, Medical Science & Generative Biology
* Food Security & Sustainable Agriculture
* Climate Change & Managing CO[2]
* Artificial Intelligence & Robotics
This is ambitious work - work that demands curiosity, courage, and a relentless drive to make a difference. At EIT, you'll join a community built on excellence, innovation, tenacity, trust, and collaboration, where bold ideas become real-world breakthroughs. Together, we push boundaries, embrace complexity, and create solutions to scale ideas from lab to society. Explore more at .
**Welcome to the Plant Biology Institute:**
The Plant Biology Institute, headed by Professor Steve Kelly, is a key part of the Ellison Institute of Technology (EIT) Oxford. The institute aims to develop impactful and commercially sustainable solutions for improving global food production and planetary health through pioneering plant science research.
The Plant Biology Institute will unite world-class researchers who are focused on expanding the frontiers of plant science. Our research is focused on enhancing our ability to feed the planet while simultaneously improving the climate and ecosystem outcomes of food production. By embedding cutting-edge plant science research within an organisation that is focused on solving global challenges at scale, we aim to accelerate the timeline from discovery to global impact.
Areas of exploration include:
* Improved plant productivity, both indoors and outside.
* Reduced reliance on inputs including water, fertilisers, pesticides, and herbicides.
* Novel decarbonised plant-based production platforms for food and medicines.
* Advanced technologies that speed up discovery and deployment in plants.
Researchers will have access to state-of-the-art laboratory and plant growth facilities and have opportunities to collaborate with experts at the forefront of research on AI, automation, and generative biology across the EIT ecosystem. They will also work with global leaders in market development, commercialisation, and impact creation. The Plant Biology Institute has long-term substantial funding to support the unique scale and ambition of its vision.
**Your Role:**
EIT is seeking a highly motivated and skilled **Scientist (all levels) in Advanced Genome Technologies** to be part of a transformative research programme at the forefront of plant biotechnology. The successful candidate will design and conduct experiments aligned with stage-gated milestones in our advanced genome technologies and/or next-generation plant transformation programme. They will work at the cutting edge of plant biotechnology, developing new and enhanced methods for genetic manipulation, plant regeneration, and DNA/RNA delivery to plants that enable a step change in our technological ability to engineer plants.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cutting edge genomic technologies, and/or next-generation plant transformation, an intrinsic motivation to translate their research into commercial solutions for real-life impact, and be a creative problem solver, ready to be part of a rapidly scaling team.
The **Scientist** will be expected to contribute to publications and IP generation and play an active role in translating research into real-world and commercial solutions aligned with EIT's mission of humane technological advancement. This role offers a unique opportunity to conduct high-impact research at the forefront of plant science while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams to drive innovation from lab to global impact.
**Your Responsibilities:**
* Drive rigorous experimental design, execution, and data interpretations, ensuring robust and reproducible scientific outcomes.
* Deliver research progress through stage gated milestones.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to incorporate cutting edge research techniques into experiments.
* Present scientific work at seminars within EIT and at external meetings, including contributing to laboratory-wide discussions on developments within the field.
* Assist in mentoring other members of the research group where appropriate.
* Collaborate with experts across the EIT ecosystem, e.g. at the forefront of research on AI, automation, and generative biology.
* Assist in the translation of scientific results into commercial opportunities consistent with the EIT humane endeavours.
* Recognise and act on opportunities for the creation of IP and cooperating in patent protection and in impact delivery.
* Conduct research ethically, in compliance with EIT policy, regulatory guidance and best scientific practice.
## Requirements
**Essential Skills, Qualifications & Experience:**
* Completed Ph.D. in molecular biology, biochemistry or other relevant discipline.
* Deep expertise and insight into cellular, molecular and synthetic biology that extends into the biochemistry and physics of molecular interactions.
* Significant experience in plant molecular biology and/or plant-microbe interactions is anticipated, though excellent candidates from other relevant backgrounds will also be considered.
* The aptitude to rapidly test diverse and ambitious new hypotheses while retaining the flexibility to recognize and pivot away from ideas that fail to show promise.
**Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**
* Elucidation and engineering of protein:protein and protein:nucleic acid interactions
o *e.g.* receptor ligand systems such as NLR R-genes, pathogen effectors and microbial secretion systems, cytoskeleton assembly and mechanics, virus/phage capsid assembly, toxin biochemistry, vesicle and membrane trafficking, manipulation of molecular motors and pumps and/or the alteration of meiotic/mitotic machinery and behavior.
* Gene editing and genome engineering beyond the production of single or multiplexed edits
o *e.g.* protein engineering of editors, genomic integration of large (multiple kb) DNA sequences, creation/delivery of artificial chromosomes and/or novel delivery of nucleic acids to plant and other cells.
* Creation of novel biological features and functions through synthetic biology with a focus on unique and impactful approaches to improving plant transformation (including through use of automation and high-throughput screening methodologies).
## Benefits
**Our Benefits:**
* Salary dependent on experience + travel allowance + bonus
* Enhanced holiday. Our annual leave allowance is 25 days plus 8 bank holidays and an additional 3 days between Christmas and New Year. You will also have the opportunity to purchase an additional 5 days annual leave in January and July.
* Pension - Employer contribution 7.5%, minimum employee contribution 5%
* Life Assurance
* Income Protection
* Private Medical Insurance as standard for you, your partner and any dependents. Including hospital Cash Plan
* Employee discounts
* Electric car scheme
* Nursery Salary Sacrifice scheme
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Family Planning
* Neurodiversity support including advise and assessments
* Coaching & Therapy services
**Working Together - What It Involves:**
During peak periods, some longer hours may be required and some working across multiple time zones due to the global nature of the programme.
