* Establish lightweight design foundations for each new bet — patterns, components, tokens — with enough system to move fast, and not so much that it calcifies around ideas we might kill.
* Plan and run validation alongside the product manager: usability sessions, concept tests, and prototypes built specifically as research instruments.
* Ship accessible by default. For enterprise learning products, WCAG conformance is a floor, not a feature.
* Flex to what the bet needs — some weeks that's deep in the codebase alongside the product engineer; others it's entirely in research, facilitation, or design.
**What you'll bring**
* Relevant of experience spanning product design and front-end engineering in any mix, with a portfolio of shipped products and prototypes you can walk us through.
* Strong front-end craft: modern TypeScript/JavaScript, React or a comparable framework, and CSS you're genuinely proud of.
* Real design skill — typography, layout, color, interaction, and motion — plus the judgment to know when polish matters and when speed does.
* Fluency across the modern toolchain: Figma for design, and AI-assisted workflows (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as a natural part of how you explore and build.
* Experience designing for complex systems: multi-role products, data-heavy interfaces, or integration-rich enterprise environments.

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.
**Ready to level up your career?**
We are looking for a **Data Protection Compliance Analyst** to join our Group Data Protection team in London, reporting to our Chief Privacy Officer. This is a role for an aspiring subject matter expert, someone curious, organised and genuinely interested in understanding how things work, who wants to grow into a specialist in data protection. You will not be expected to arrive as the finished article. You will be expected to be inquisitive, to read closely, to ask questions, and to learn fast, because we will invest real time in teaching you. If you enjoy piecing information together until the full picture appears, read on.
## Job Description
**Your Influential Mission: You Will...**
* Own the day-to-day record keeping that sits at the heart of our data protection framework, creating, maintaining and quality-checking records so they always tell an accurate story
* Support a Group-wide review of our Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), making sure every legal entity has up-to-date documentation of the personal data it processes, as the law requires
* Help run our data mapping exercise, building and maintaining a clear, current view of where personal data lives and how it moves across the business
* Assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), helping identify, document and assess higher-risk processing activities
* Support supplier and system due diligence, gathering information, tracking reviews and flagging anything that needs a closer look
* Highlight potential data protection risks and help track the actions taken to resolve them
* Work closely with colleagues across the business, explaining requirements clearly and following up until things are done properly
* Learn continuously, through structured training, mentoring from the team, and the work itself
## Qualifications
**Components for Success: You...**
* Want to grow your career in data protection, privacy, compliance or regulation, this is a step forward, not a step down
* Read carefully and enjoy it, you can take a long document and pull out what actually matters
* Communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and out loud, with people at every level
* Can explain something precisely enough that someone who cannot see it still understands it
* Are highly organised and detail-orientated, and take pride in getting the small things right
* Are proactive, you spot what needs doing and start it, rather than waiting to be asked
* Are comfortable with structured, repetitive work when it builds real understanding, and are curious about the 'why' behind it
* Are confident with spreadsheets and comfortable working with structured information
* Are fluent in written and spoken English
* Are based in, or able to work from, London on a hybrid basis (currently three days a week in the office)
**You’ll Get Extra Points for...**
* Any exposure to compliance, regulatory, legal, risk or data protection work, whether through your studies or a previous role
* Experience in an office-based customer service environment, our best privacy professionals often come from backgrounds where they learned complaints handling, ethics and clear correspondence
* Experience in a regulated sector such as banking, financial services, gaming or with a regulator
* Experience preparing or delivering presentations
* A genuine interest in technology, social media and artificial intelligence, and how they intersect with privacy
* A relevant degree or certification in law, compliance, information governance or data protection welcome, but never a substitute for curiosity
**Thrive in a culture that values...**
* Real investment in you, structured training, hands-on mentoring from experienced privacy professionals, and the space to ask questions
* Genuine exposure: you will work across our legal entities and business units, and see how a FTSE-listed international group handles privacy end to end
* A team that explains the reasoning, not just the task, you will understand the story behind every record you keep
* Hybrid working and a culture built on trust, transparency and delivery rather than clock-watching
* An international, inclusive environment where diverse thinking is treated as a business advantage
* The chance to build real depth in one of the most in-demand disciplines in technology today

OverviewApplication
## **About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
## **About the role**
We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.
In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
## **Who you'll be working with and reporting to**
You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.
Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.
## **What you'll be doing**
As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:
* Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions
* Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity
* Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution
* Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails
* Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee
* Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly
* Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team
* Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign
* Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them
* Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time
* Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit
* Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner
## **What you bring**
You'll thrive in this role if you have:
* 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role
* Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further
* A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors
* Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice
* A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways
* Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively
## **Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
* You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works
* You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them
* You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance
* You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working
* You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next
This role is not a good fit for you if:
* You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
* You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work
* You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams
* You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation
## **How you'll develop in this role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:
* Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations
* Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes
* Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation
* Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale
We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.
## **The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
## **Show me the benefits!**
* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work
## **The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
* **Intro call:** A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background
* **Hiring Manager:** A 45-minute chat with our Head of Safeguarding & Reconciliation
* **Pleo challenge:** A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges
* **Final Interview:** A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders
Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:
* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.
## **About your application**
* **English first.** Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* **A fair look for everyone.** Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* **Diversity drives us.** We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* **Interview at your best.** We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* **Your data is safe.** When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* **Applying for multiple roles?** Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* **Reapplying.** If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

**TLDR:** Plinth builds software for charities, foundations and funders. 13,000+ UK organisations use us, we add 7+ clients a month, and we ship constantly. You'll be the first person customers reach, but you'll be judged on whether fewer of them need to reach you next quarter, and on being able to prove it. A strong first or second job: you'll touch support, product, engineering and operations in your first month.
## What you'll own
* **Your own workload.** You start as first responder in Intercom, and your job is to make that role smaller every quarter. Falling volume with rising satisfaction is the metric, not tickets closed
* **Measurement.** PostHog, Intercom and Linear are yours: the ticket tagging that makes volume analysable, the dashboards showing where users get stuck, the view of whether fixes shipped and queries stopped. Right now we can't see our own support data clearly enough to know if we're improving. That's your problem to solve
* **Free Plinth.** Thousands of small charities who could never afford software like this get it anyway, and they test new functionality at volume. You own their experience and argue their case internally, and know when it will make the product better for everyone.
* **Self-serve.** Help articles, in-app guidance, website content and the chatbot behind them. A product with an audience, not a wiki that gets tidied when things are quiet
* **Support tooling.** Find the queries that shouldn't need a human, then build or spec the thing that removes them: a status page, a clearer error message, an automation, a self-serve action. You're expected to spot it, make the case and see it land
* **The loop into product.** Recommendations backed by evidence, not anecdote: here's the query volume, here's the funnel showing where it starts, here's what we change, here's how we'll know it worked. Then follow it until the cause is fixed, not the symptom
* **Escalation and response.** Customers hear back in minutes, not tomorrow, and stay informed until it's genuinely resolved
## What we're looking for
* You work without handholding. We'll give you context and a clear idea of what good looks like, not a daily list
* Repetition bothers you. Answering the same question by hand for the tenth time should feel like a bug you own
* You think past the ticket in front of you: why did this reach me at all, and what would stop the next fifty
* You reach for a number rather than a feeling. You don't need to arrive knowing PostHog, just to enjoy turning a messy pile of tickets into a chart that settles an argument
* You'll advocate for users internally, including the ones who don't pay us
* You're properly organised. Tickets, escalations, half-written articles and an invoice query all live at once, nothing quietly dropped
* You write clearly and fast, to stressed non-technical people. Warm, unpatronising, honest when something's broken
* You've run something yourself: a society, a side project, a process you rebuilt in a part-time job
* Charity sector experience and technical confidence are both real advantages
## What good looks like after a year
* The top recurring queries from your first month no longer exist
* Support volume per customer has fallen while the company has grown, and we can see it on a dashboard you built
* Anyone at Plinth can answer "are we getting better at support?" in thirty seconds
* You can point at paid features that shipped better because free users hit the problems first
**Recent graduates welcome.** We care more about how you think, write and organise yourself than what you've done before. If you want ownership rather than a narrow lane, this offers more range in a year than most graduate schemes manage in three.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to be handed fully specified tickets and churn out code. We need someone who wants to get involved while problems are still being clarified, workflows are being understood, trade-offs are being discussed, and the right platform shape is still emerging.
You’ll be the first fully allocated technical contributor within a new team that will grow with you to up to 3 fully allocated engineers, as well as additional resource pulled in from other pods. You’ll own substantial parts of the platform from early shaping through to production, help establish its technical foundations, contribute strongly to architectural direction, mentor other engineers, and raise the standard for how the team plans, builds, reviews and operates its work.
You will not be expected to arrive with every answer. You will be expected to create clarity, make good decisions, test assumptions quickly, and take meaningful ownership rather than waiting for somebody else to define the path.
This is a fully remote, UK-based role with the expectation to travel to London approximately once per month. We are not currently hiring this role as an overseas remote position.
**What We’re Building**
The Agentic Layer will give AI agents and automation workflows safe, useful context about how Pretzl operates: who people are, which clients and projects matter, what work is in flight, what has already been agreed, what has changed, and which information can appropriately be used for a particular task.
This is not a generic chatbot, a thin wrapper around an LLM, or simply a vector database connected to company documents.
The platform needs to understand business entities, relationships, ownership, permissions, project state, decisions, risks, workflows and source systems. It must be able to load the right context for a task without exposing information the user is not entitled to access.
We expect to use external models, frameworks, connectors and infrastructure where that makes sense. The capabilities we need to own are the parts that are specific to how Pretzl works: our context and memory models, permission boundaries, business events, source-of-truth decisions, evaluation criteria and rules around how agents can use information and take action.
The first version will not attempt to create a universal agent for the whole business. We will begin with a small number of valuable, clearly defined workflows where we can understand the users, context, systems, permissions, approval points and measures of success.
**What You’ll Actually Do**
Greenfield Technical Ownership
* Help turn the Agentic Layer vision into a practical, evolvable technical direction
* Own substantial areas of the platform from early shaping through to production operation
* Identify the important architectural decisions, assumptions, risks and unknowns rather than waiting for them to be surfaced by somebody else
* Work out what needs to be built now, what can be deferred, and what should be bought, reused or integrated
* Establish sensible technical foundations without over-engineering a platform before its first workflows have proved value
* Turn broad platform ambitions into narrow, testable vertical slices that create real business value
* Make architectural decisions within your domain and clearly articulate the trade-offs
* Design systems that are secure, observable, testable, maintainable and appropriately scalable
* Lead debugging and incident investigation for complex issues, looking for systemic causes rather than treating symptoms
* Write code that serves as an example for the rest of the team
Agentic Systems, Context and Integrations
* Build production-grade TypeScript and Node.js services, APIs and internal tools
* Design context-loading approaches that identify what an agent needs to know for a specific user, client, project or workflow
* Help shape models for business entities, events, decisions, risks, workflows and durable memory
* Build permission-aware access across connected systems and document repositories
* Create reliable integrations with workplace and business platforms such as Slack, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Teams, Snowflake, Jira, Figma and internal systems
* Design agent workflows that can call approved tools, maintain state, handle failures and pause for human approval where required
* Apply agentic patterns such as tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, Model Context Protocol and human-in-the-loop workflows pragmatically
* Build clear boundaries around tool access, credentials, identity, sensitive data and external actions
* Establish tracing, logging and auditability so that we can understand what an agent saw, why it acted, which tools it used and what happened
* Build evaluation and feedback mechanisms that help us identify missing context, weak outputs, unsafe behaviour and genuinely valuable workflows
* Protect the platform against risks including permission leakage, prompt injection, stale context, unintended data disclosure and uncontrolled tool execution
Product and Workflow Collaboration
* Work directly with product leadership, stakeholders and your squad to identify workflows worth solving
* Get close to how teams currently work rather than designing a platform around abstract AI capabilities
* Help turn ambiguous operational problems into clear technical approaches and sensible delivery plans
* Challenge unclear assumptions and proposed solutions constructively
* Help identify which systems should be treated as sources of truth for different types of business information
* Clarify gaps, dependencies, permission boundaries and operational risks before they become delivery blockers
* Communicate technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Distinguish between an impressive demonstration and a workflow that will remain reliable in real business use
* Proactively identify and raise risks before they become critical
Delivery Quality
* Own delivery quality as well as implementation
* Break larger platform opportunities into small, reviewable, outcome-connected pieces of work
* Create clear technical plans and pull requests that explain the reasoning behind the implementation, not just the code changes
* Ensure work is meaningfully tested and production-ready
* Design for unreliable APIs, asynchronous processing, partial failure, retries and changing external systems
* Build appropriate observability and operational controls into the work rather than adding them afterwards
* Keep changes focused, understandable and maintainable
* Surface uncertainty early rather than allowing unclear work to drift into delivery
* Use AI development tools thoughtfully, treating tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex as collaborators that help explore and challenge solutions, not shortcuts that bypass understanding
Team Development
* Actively mentor and collaborate with other engineers through pairing, design discussions, code reviews and feedback
* Help other engineers develop stronger architectural and product judgement, not just stronger technical execution
* Create opportunities for others to take ownership and stretch their capabilities
* Champion engineering practices that improve clarity, quality, security and pace
* Help establish the working practices of a newly forming team
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding activities
**What We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for a strong Senior Engineer who is excited by the opportunity to build an AI-enabled internal platform from the ground up.
You do not need to be a machine learning researcher. This role is primarily about building secure, reliable production software around models: integrations, context, permissions, workflows, tools, data, evaluation and operational controls.
You should be comfortable taking ownership in an environment where the destination is clear but the route still needs to be worked out.
Essential
* A sustained track record of operating effectively at Senior Engineer level; this is not intended as a first Senior Engineer appointment
* Strong professional experience building production software with TypeScript and Node.js
* Proven ownership of complex, ambiguous or business-critical initiatives from early shaping through to production
* Confidence joining a greenfield project and helping establish its architecture, technical standards and delivery approach
* Ability to create clarity from ambiguity, make pragmatic decisions and move work forward without waiting for complete specifications
* Strong experience designing, consuming and maintaining third-party API integrations
* Good understanding of authentication, authorisation, permissions models, identity and secure data handling
* Experience with databases, queues, background jobs, events, webhooks or other asynchronous system patterns
* Practical experience building with LLM APIs, tool calling, agent workflows, retrieval systems or AI-enabled software
* Ability to design systems that handle sensitive business data with appropriate access control, auditability, observability and human oversight
* Strong product engineering judgement, including the ability to turn broad operational problems into simple, reliable software
* A pragmatic approach to architecture, testing, maintainability, technical debt and operational risk
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical colleagues
* A track record of mentoring other engineers and raising the quality of the wider team
* Curiosity about what AI can genuinely improve, combined with healthy scepticism around reliability, privacy, security and hype
Nice to Have
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly useful:
* Building MCP servers, MCP clients, tool registries or secure agent-accessible APIs
* Slack, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Teams, Google Workspace, Jira, Snowflake, Figma or similar workplace and business-system APIs
* Permission-aware retrieval, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, document indexing or source-attributed answer generation
* Agent SDKs, workflow frameworks or application libraries such as the OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic tooling, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK or equivalent approaches
* Agent harnesses or coding-agent environments such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenHands or similar systems
* Evaluation frameworks, tracing, red-teaming, AI security testing or observability for nondeterministic systems
* Designing secure access across multiple clients, business units, teams or document repositories
* Building internal platforms, workflow automation products or operational intelligence systems
You do not need experience with every item in this list. We care more about whether you understand the underlying engineering problems and can make good decisions as the technology continues to change.
Deal-breakers
* If you’re looking for a role where the platform has already been designed and you only need to implement tickets, this isn’t for you
* If you’re primarily interested in prototypes and impressive demonstrations rather than reliable production systems, this isn’t for you
* If you believe connecting an LLM to a collection of documents is the complete architecture, this isn’t for you
* If you are comfortable giving agents broad access to tools or company data without clear permission boundaries, auditability and human control, this isn’t for you
* If you use AI tools to generate systems you cannot explain, debug or maintain, this isn’t for you
**Our Likely Starting Stack**
Some decisions will be made with the engineers joining the team, but our expected starting point is:
* Application development: TypeScript, Node.js
* Data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake and appropriate retrieval or indexing infrastructure
* Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker
* Integrations: Slack, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, OneDrive and other business-system APIs
* Agentic capabilities: LLM APIs, typed tool interfaces, MCP and workflow or agent SDKs selected according to the problem
* Operations: Structured logging, tracing, evaluation, audit history and production monitoring
We expect the team to make deliberate choices rather than adopting frameworks for their own sake. TypeScript and Node.js are the default because they fit our existing engineering organisation and make the platform easier for other Pretzl engineers to understand, review and contribute to.
If a genuine architectural reason emerges to use another technology for part of the platform, we are open to that decision being made consciously by the team.
**Why Pretzl?**
Sustainable Pace, Real Balance
We believe great work happens when people have space to live their lives. No crunch culture, no expectation to be always-on. We trust you to do excellent work within reasonable hours.
We have offices across the UK with a hybrid working policy, and are open to remote applicants if you’re not located close to an office.
A Genuine Greenfield Opportunity
This is not a role where the interesting platform decisions have already been made elsewhere.
You’ll join early enough to influence how the system is designed, how the team operates, which capabilities we own, which technologies we use, and how we prove value safely. Your judgement will have a direct effect on the shape of the platform.
At the same time, greenfield does not mean architecture for architecture’s sake. We will build around real workflows, real users and measurable outcomes.

You’ll work collaboratively from workflow discovery and problem definition through solution shaping, build, review, release and evaluation. Your input will matter at every stage, and you’ll help the team move towards shared ownership of product outcomes.
Clear Career Progression

We review progress against this roadmap regularly and encourage the development and growth of our people.
Product Team Operating Model
We work together to solve real problems, not just deliver pre-written requirements.
Product and engineering each bring different expertise, and the best solutions come from those perspectives being involved early enough to shape the work properly.
You’ll have genuine autonomy and ownership over the solutions you build, while also helping us establish the habits that make that model work well: clear problem framing, sensible vertical slicing, fast feedback loops, thoughtful trade-offs and high-quality delivery.
Global Impact, Focused Team
Work with a small, focused squad within an approx. 350-person global organisation.
You get the best of both worlds: the resources and impact of an established international business, with the autonomy, proximity and influence of a newly forming product team.
**Compensation and Benefits**
What You’ll Get

# Lead Data Engineer
Cape Town
We're a tech and product consultancy, building enterprise software products for blue-chip companies, multinationals and PLC's. The best thing about Red Badger is, of course, the team. We've been around for 15+ years now, and we are over 120 strong. We are really proud of our people; we support and learn a lot from each other, work really hard, and have fun doing it. We are a diverse group made up of 22 different nationalities, speaking 17 languages. Headquartered in London, we also have offices in Cape Town and Leeds.
**The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data & AI delivery function. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: you'll work directly within a team of data engineers and a Tech Lead to design and build complex data solutions for our clients, from discovery through to production. Based in Leeds with a national remit, you'll pair regularly with other engineers and bring strong technical judgement to the problems you're solving.
The work we do for our clients involves the core complexities of their business, and the technology we use varies from project to project.
You love solving complex problems, and customer value is your north star. You're comfortable working across ambiguity, and you're a technology polyglot with an evangelist's enthusiasm for Agile ways of working.
Day to day, you'll be predominantly hands-on: building pipelines, designing data models, and pairing with other engineers on the team. You'll also contribute to technical decisions, support your Tech Lead in shaping solutions, and help to mentor and grow other engineers.
## **Key Responsibilities**
**Discipline Expertise**
* **Technology breadth:** Production-grade experience across AWS and/or Azure native services, with strong hands-on Databricks and/or Snowflake, using the right tool for the job across the full data lifecycle.
* **On AWS:** comfortable across core storage, processing and data management services (e.g. S3, Glue, Redshift, Lake Formation)
* **On Azure:** comfortable across core storage, processing and data management services (e.g. Fabric, Synapse, Purview)
* **Strong hands-on experience** in **Databricks** and/or **Snowflake** across ingestion, transformation and serving
* **Data capabilities:** Confident across the full data lifecycle, OLTP and OLAP, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and cataloguing, through to analytics and decision-making.
* **Architecture patterns:** Understands medallion, data mesh/fabric, and when RAG or serverless patterns apply, working within an established reference architecture.
* **Data Product mentality:** You build with discoverability, addressability and security in mind, focused on outcomes rather than just moving data.
* **AI:** You understand how AI capability is built and deployed on modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) and cloud-native services, and can implement AI-enabled features such as RAG pipelines with appropriate safeguards.
* **Hands-on mindset:** Fluent in SQL and Python/PySpark (or Scala/R). Comfortable with open formats including Parquet, Iceberg and JSON
**Agile Ways of Working**
* Contribute actively to agile ceremonies, helping to shape and improve the process
* Pair regularly with other engineers, including designers and cross-functional team members
* Advocate for lean development, building for what's required now
* Write tested, production-grade, maintainable code
**Consulting with Clients**
* Build strong working relationships with client technical stakeholders
* Communicate progress and technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences when needed
* Support the upskilling of client teams in modern data practices where relevant
**Growth & Collaboration**
+ Support and mentor less experienced engineers through pairing and code review
+ Bring the Red Badger culture with you: low-ego, collaborative, and open to challenge
+ Contribute technical opinions confidently, while staying open to being wrong
## **Your experience**
**It’d be great if:**
* You are a **Quality Advocate:** You take pride in the integrity of your work and champion quality assurance and performance tuning.
* You are an **Industry Steward:** A lifelong learner who keeps a pulse on industry standards and best practices.
* **You care deeply** about high-quality work that delivers real value
* **You're comfortable with ambiguity** and solving complex problems collaboratively
* **You bring strong expertise in your craft**, alongside a willingness to keep learning
* **You communicate clearly** and build trust fast with engineering peers and client stakeholders
* **You're pragmatic**, adaptable, outcome-focused and low-ego in multidisciplinary teams
**It’d be amazing if you can also:**
* Show a track record of delivering complex data projects end-to-end
* Articulate technical trade-offs in terms of business impact, right tool for the job
* Demonstrate experience across more than one of the core platforms (AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake)
* Be part of the public face of the company at meetups, conferences, etc.

Blue Bear is a leading autonomy and unmanned systems company. We are continuously innovating within the core area of Autonomy and Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) such as air vehicles, autopilots, navigation solutions, mission systems and ground control stations. We are currently seeking engineers to help conceptualise, size and mature the next generation of our air vehicle platforms.
We are seeking a UAV Concept Engineer to strengthen our early-stage design capability: turning requirements and CONOPS into sized, analysed and testable air vehicle concepts through rapid, iterative trade studies. This role is central to our conceptual design loop, by early exploring design trade space and rapidly iterating through geometry, aerodynamics, weights, propulsion, mission and stability.
A defining part of this role is closing the loop between analysis and reality. You will synthesise data from bench and flight testing, flight logs, telemetry and measured performance and feed it back to correct and improve our conceptual models, sizing methods and surrogates, so each design iteration is grounded in real evidence.
Working as part of the Concepts team, you will bring a proactive, collaborative approach and a passion for fast iteration, sound engineering judgement and building tools and methods that make the whole team faster.

* Develop and morph parametric air vehicle geometry and Outer Mould Line and drive it through the analysis loop, regenerating a concept from a defined parameter set.
* Produce the core conceptual outputs each iteration: drag polars, lift curves, weight breakdowns, mission energy/endurance, static margin, trim and control authority.
* Run trade studies and design-space exploration to make optimisation and sensitivity studies fast enough to explore many designs.
* Synthesise flight-test and bench-test data (flight logs, telemetry, measured aero/propulsion performance) and use it to validate, calibrate and improve conceptual models and sizing methods.
* Select and shape propulsion system concepts and integrate them into mission and energy-network performance analysis.
* Maintain, improve and where appropriate build the concept-design toolchain and automation that underpins rapid iteration (geometry, aero, mission, surrogate and data-processing tools).
* Capture and communicate design risk, where the design is immature or sensitive and feed it into the programme risk register.

* We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience in aircraft sizing, concept-design tooling, and the synthesis of flight-test data to improve models
* Demonstrable experience in aircraft / UAV conceptual design and sizing, constraint analysis, weight and mission/energy sizing, and closing a design point.
* Hands-on experience with conceptual and preliminary design tools such as OpenVSP, RCAIDE, AVL, XFLR5, Datcom or equivalent in-house tools.

* Experience synthesising flight logs / telemetry / test data and using it to validate and improve analytical models (model calibration, correlation to test).
* Strong scripting and analysis skills in Python (or similar) for automation, data processing and building/using design tools.
* Working understanding of the full conceptual design loop: geometry, aerodynamics, weights, propulsion, mission performance and stability & control, and how the disciplines couple.

* Stability & control analysis, flight dynamics modelling, and handling-qualities assessment.

* Propulsion sizing and integration of electric, hybrid-electric or gas turbine systems.
* Experience with PX4 / ArduPilot, SITL/HITL simulation, and processing autopilot flight logs (ULog, MAVLink).

## Founding Talent Partner
****About Saturn****
Saturn is a Series A-backed fintech transforming how financial advice is delivered.
We operate in one of the world’s largest industries. Wealth and asset managers oversee more than $100 trillion and generate over $1 trillion in annual revenue, yet much of the infrastructure used to manage that wealth remains fragmented, manual and institution-specific.
Saturn is starting with the productivity and compliance systems used by financial advisers.
****Our story****
Saturn joined Y Combinator in 2024 and became one of the fastest-growing B2B companies in its batch.
We grew organically to a meaningful share of the UK financial advice market before acquiring the legacy leader, one of the industry’s most established compliance rule engine and suitability businesses, in 2025.
That acquisition combined AI-native product engineering with more than two decades of regulatory expertise, proprietary compliance logic and deep industry distribution.
Within two years of launch, Saturn became the leading provider of AI transformation to UK financial advice firms, supporting more than 9,000 regulated advice professionals who manage about $500bn in assets.
We have proved distribution, trust and demand. The most important infrastructure is still ahead of us.
****Your role****
We are building the most talent-dense company in London. That is the mandate you are being hired for.
Hiring is one of the company’s top priorities, and it shows: Founders are in the process, they move fast on strong candidates, and they hold the bar. Until now, hiring has been run directly by founders and Operations. There is a working process, a live ATS, real pipelines and roles being filled. What there isn’t yet is someone whose whole job is to make it exceptional.
That is you. As Founding Talent Partner you own hiring end to end, across every function: engineering, design, partnerships, implementation, support, operations and finance. You understand what exceptional looks like at Saturn, go and find it, and hold the bar when a role gets hard to fill.
You will also build the function. The interview architecture, the ATS, the sourcing engine and the hiring data are yours to sharpen, and every search you run leaves behind infrastructure.
It is an intense seat. Concurrent searches, a high bar and hiring decisions the whole company feels. You are never carrying it alone. Do this well and the function grows around you, with a team to lead.
****The Team****
Small and high-calibre by design. Everyone here is someone the rest of the company learns from, and at our stage that quality is fragile: every hire is visible, every hire compounds, and one wrong hire is felt across the company.
You will be the first dedicated talent hire. That comes with real autonomy, real support, and real accountability. What you learn in the market becomes how Saturn hires.
You will report to our Head of Operations, who has been running hiring to date and will hand it over properly rather than throw you, also collaborating weekly with the Founders on headcount planning, prioritisation and closing, and directly with every function leader on their roles.
****What You’ll Do****
* Own end-to-end hiring across every function, from intake and sourcing through screening, interview management, offer and close, for technical, commercial and central roles.
* Source and manage a high volume of candidates through direct outreach, referrals, communities, events and market mapping, keeping tight feedback loops with hiring managers and founders.
* Build deep partnerships with the founders and function leaders: run headcount planning, calibrate profiles, challenge assumptions on what “good” looks like, and execute against the hiring plan.
* Take the existing process and make it excellent: structured interview loops per function, scorecards, interviewer calibration and training, and best practice that holds as the team scales.
* Own the ATS end to end. Clean data for reporting, disciplined pipeline hygiene, resurfaced silver medallists, job posts, pre-hire checks, and agency relationships only where they earn their place.
* Own pipeline analytics: funnel conversion, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, interview-to-offer ratios, and offer-acceptance rates. Surface insights weekly to hiring managers, the Head of Operations and the founders.
* Translate data into action: diagnose bottlenecks, recommend interventions, and report results to stakeholders in a format they can act on.
* Develop a deep understanding of the mission, the product and the regulation so you can pitch the opportunity credibly and close people who have other options on the table.
* Run offers with judgement: benchmark the market, advise on levelling and equity, negotiate, and close.
* Build long-range talent strategies grounded in pipeline data, including referral programmes, sourcing channel optimisation, talent pools and process automation.
* Build Saturn’s talent brand alongside the founders and Marketing: content, events, referrals and a story about the problem that makes strong people seek us out.
* Conduct screens with a high signal-to-noise ratio, demonstrated by strong interview-to-offer conversion.
* Drive diverse talent into the company and deliver a candidate experience that holds up regardless of outcome, through proactive and transparent communication.
****What We’re Looking For****
* 5+ years full-cycle recruiting, including time at a fast-growing Series A or B startup.
* Generalist track record: technical and commercial roles from the same seat, and the speed to get credible in an unfamiliar function fast.
* Expert direct sourcing in competitive markets, with the confidence to approach someone brilliant who has never heard of us, and the resourcefulness to reach people the obvious channels miss.
* Experience managing hiring-manager relationships: profile calibration, weekly pipeline reviews, and data-backed recommendations on strategy and prioritisation.
* Demonstrated ability to use pipeline data to drive decisions, including funnel analysis, conversion benchmarking and source ROI, and to report those insights to senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to design and improve hiring process: structured interviews, scorecards, interviewer training, and a clean ATS others can rely on for reporting.
* Experience running multiple concurrent funnels and keeping candidates moving without drop-off.
* Exceptional at selling the opportunity, negotiating and closing, with a clear grasp of comp benchmarking and levelling.
* A bar you will defend. You have held a “no” that everyone wanted to be a “yes”, and been right. Talent density is built one of those at a time.
* The judgement to challenge. You can tell a founder their profile, process or bar is wrong and have them thank you for it.
* Clear, structured communication with candidates, plus care that outlasts the outcome.
* Desire to write the playbook rather than inherit one, and the long-term thinking to stay and see it pay off.
* No task is beneath you. Bias to action, autonomous, and highly collaborative across a small, fast-moving team.
****What We Offer****
* Competitive salary with regular appraisals
* Competitive equity package at an early stage company with high growth potential
* Our beautiful new five-floor office, “The Dome”, equipped with an onsite gym and roof terrace
* Best-in-class dental and medical insurance
* A dedicated budget for learning and professional development
* Access to an additional world-class gym and wellness centre two minutes from the office
* A tight-knit, ambitious team that cares deeply about quality and each other

Savanta is looking for an experienced engineering team lead to lead an agile team building a cutting-edge AI platform for market research.
About Us:
Savanta is a leading data, market research and advisory company helping the world's leading brands make better decisions, faster. With over 500 people across offices in multiple countries, we combine deep research expertise, proprietary technology and high-impact consulting to give our clients a complete view of their markets, their customers and their competitors.
About the Role:
Modern AI has created new possibilities in market research, the ability to use real world market data and AI models to generate synthetic responses to market research questions. You will lead the team responsible for Virtual Personas, Savanta’s synthetic personas solution built using our unique data set.
This role is based in our London office, with the expectation to be onsite 1-3 days per week. All candidates will be considered equally, however, unfortunately we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.
You will lead up to 4 engineers working in a cross functional agile team alongside a product manager, with input from our UX designer and QA teams. The team is to deliver the product roadmap alongside driving further adoption of cloud first technologies; we are Azure based, with PostgreSQL and MongoDB as our primary data stores and a multi-provider LLM stack (OpenAI, Google Gemini and Anthropic).
We want you to dive in, get your hands dirty, and figure things out, but also to be someone your team can rely on for help and guidance when they need it.
Our Tech Team works within a learning and collaborative environment, where empowerment is key to our success, along with developing a culture of innovation and creating an environment where everyone can excel.
This is a great opportunity to lead engineering in a totally new field using cutting edge technology. Virtual Personas sits at the frontier of applied AI in the industry and has the potential to fundamentally change the way market research is done. Savanta intends to be a pioneer in this area and is putting in the investment to ensure that happens.
You'll also be responsible for:
* Part of a team responsible for setting direction for Virtual Personas
* Delivery of the Product roadmap
* Managing a team consisting of a range of skillsets and experience
* Full stack development, across Python/FastAPI services and React/TypeScript front ends
* Continuously improving the team's processes for iterative development, including embedding automated testing and CI quality gates into a fast-moving AI product
* Championing the responsible and secure use of LLMs - including prompt-injection awareness, defensive design, and sound data handling for personas built on real respondent data
* Setting technical direction for the team
* Interacting directly with customers, understanding their needs, and generalising them
* Finding ways to build fast, scalable, flexible systems without blowing the budget
* Mentoring, supporting, and encouraging our developers
* Conducting regular 121's, setting objectives and assisting with tailored development plans
Our engineering environment includes technologies such as Python (FastAPI), LangChain/ LangGraph for multi-agent LLM orchestration, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Azure (App Service, Container Registry, Blob Storage), Docker, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
About You:
You will have a strong engineering background, and a track record of leading teams that have launched and scaled up new products while maintaining good engineering practices. You will be innovative and comfortable with working in a rapidly evolving business area.
Essential Criteria:
* Experience leading agile rapid release iterations, ideally on fast-moving AI/LLM-powered products
* Extensive experience specifically with Python and modern async web frameworks, or experience in closely related languages
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining LLM-powered applications - prompt design, multi-provider integration, and agent orchestration (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph or an equivalent framework)
* Strong RDBMS experience (e.g. PostgreSQL) and comfort with document stores (e.g. MongoDB) and caching layers (e.g. Redis)
* Comfortable working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of the daily workflow
* A willingness to learn - new technologies (including emerging AI tooling), our business and platform, and ways of working - is an absolute must
* Full product delivery mindset focused on a tested user experience
* Encourages a test-first approach as part of stories, aiming for high automated coverage, and comfortable establishing CI quality gates (lint, type-check, test) where they don't yet exist
* Runs meetings such as project kick-offs, stakeholder check-ins, and retrospectives
* Comfortable with some ambiguity and shifting priorities in your work environment, and comfortable with managed change
* Confident in using spikes to de-risk work as well as guiding the team in iterating towards a long-term scalable architecture - including hardening AI features against risks such as prompt injection and unbounded model behaviour
Desirable Criteria:
* Experience with FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, and/or Node/Express
* Experience with React/TypeScript front-end development
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other multi-agent/LLM orchestration frameworks
* Experience configuring Azure services (App Service, Container Registry, Blob Storage) or AWS equivalents
* Familiarity with LLM observability/evaluation tooling (e.g. Langfuse) and resilience patterns for third-party AI providers (e.g. circuit breakers, provider fallback)
* Awareness of data protection and AI transparency considerations relevant to handling panel/respondent data and AI-generated outputs (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act) - as context for engineering decisions, not as a compliance determination
* Experience/interest of informal leadership or formal management experience
* Experience working across team boundaries with stakeholders
And in return, Savanta offers:
* Salary range: £90,000 - £100,000
* Bonus scheme
* Unlimited annual leave
* Hybrid working
* Flexible working practices
* Ongoing Training & Development
* Health & Wellbeing package
* Financial Health (pension, life assurance, etc.)
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Team & Company Socials
* Committees for Health & Well Being, Charities & Volunteering and DE&I
Why Join Us:
Part of the vibrant Next 15 Communications Group, we have an entrepreneurial and inclusive company culture that actively recognizes and values its people and offers unrivalled scope for career development, including mentoring, coaching as well as extensive training programs.

* Help shape the future of UX design on STFC, both through new features and through your own principles, practices, and standards.

* Build deep knowledge of the game to effectively step into the player’s shoes and ground your design decisions in real player perspectives and experiences.

You will set direction for them, build the case, sequence the work and then go and ship it.

We need someone who understands their role is about outcomes and growth, not just delivery. You will be measured on what changed in the market rather than what left the sprint. Activation, conversion, retention, revenue per customer: you will identify what needs to move, how to do it and then measure. Epics and stories good enough that engineering never has to guess. Releases that are tracked, measured and changed on the evidence.
We are looking for someone who is AI-native and hands on. It is a core part of the role rather than an extra. We need a product team that builds with AI directly: stories written with enough precision that a coding agent can implement them, and prototypes built with designers to define the "what" before engineering commits to the "how". We are a small team, a short distance between an idea and a decision, and a lot of responsibility. * Thinks in agents and connectors. We are working out what SeedLegals looks like when a founder's or an investor's own AI can reach our platform directly through MCP, and what has to be right on trust, state and permissions first. There is a substantial piece of that to own.

* Five or more years driving product with engineers and designers. You may come from any background but AI has been a governing force for you and you can implement workflows to optimise its use. We're looking to change how we work with AI helping drive those changes.
* You can operate at a senior level, with ownership of outcomes rather than output.
* You know your market in real detail: who the competitors are, what they charge, what they released last month, where they are weak, and what is changing in the rules. You form a view from it and you are willing to change that view.

Four hundred and twenty million people suffer from chronic eye disease; it is the leading cause of sight loss in the developed world. To prevent people going blind, clinicians take sub-surface images of the back of the eye so that the condition can be diagnosed and managed appropriately. This uses a device called an optical coherence tomography machine, or ‘OCT’, which currently require bulky, desk-sized workstations. Siloton is developing the first truly portable OCT to provide better access to diagnostic and monitoring services for everyone who needs it. Based on Siloton’s world-leading photonic chip technology, this will reduce the burden of treatment while removing bottlenecks in the clinical pipeline, alleviating pressure on healthcare systems and ensuring patients receive the best possible care, wherever and whoever they are.

This is a wide-ranging technical role, covering many aspects of integrated photonics, with a diverse and interesting set of problems to solve. Your primary responsibilities will be to work with the CTO to complete the design, development, and implementation of photonic chips fundamental to prototype development and patient imaging. # Director of Content
**About Us**
Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and
receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.
Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they
choose to grow. We deliver services across:

• Foreign Exchange (FX)
• Treasury management
• Finance reconciliations
We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America.
Backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining
how businesses move money worldwide.
Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our
community is growing fast. As we continue to scale, we’re building a team of exceptional
people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments
**About the Role:**
As Director of Content, you will own Sokin’s global content strategy and the operating model
behind it. You will turn our company strategy, product innovation, customer insight and
market expertise into a distinctive body of work that builds authority with CFOs, treasurers,
finance leaders and the wider fintech ecosystem.
You will lead a distributed team across London, Dubai and New York, spanning content
strategy, writing, production and video. You will set the editorial bar, decide where Sokin
should lead the conversation and build a high-output production system that delivers quality
at pace.
This is not a role for someone who only manages a calendar or commissions work from a
distance. You will be a hands-on leader: shaping big ideas, editing important work,
developing senior voices and helping the team turn complex financial subjects into content
people actively choose to read, watch and share.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Content strategy and narrative**
• Set and continually evolve Sokin’s global content strategy, editorial point of view and
priority narratives.
• Translate business priorities, product direction and customer problems into a
focused editorial agenda for CFO, treasury and finance audiences.
• Create a clear architecture across thought leadership, product storytelling, customer
proof, campaigns, executive content.
• Identify the topics Sokin has the authority to own, and build recognisable franchises
and formats around them.
• Protect a consistent voice while ensuring content remains useful, specific and
relevant across markets.
**Editorial leadership and production**
• Lead the end-to-end development of flagship work, from the original insight and
brief through writing, editing, production and distribution.
• Work closely with the social team to translate core editorial ideas into platform-
native content that earns attention across channels. Use audience behaviour and
performance insights to strengthen future commissioning, creating a clear feedback
loop between what the team produces, how it is distributed and what resonates.
• Set a high editorial and creative bar across long-form, short-form and video content;
give direct, constructive feedback that improves the work.
• Personally shape and edit high-value pieces including reports, executive narratives,
major launches, customer stories, scripts and opinion-led content.
• Develop a repeatable system that turns one strong idea into multiple valuable
formats rather than simply increasing output.
**Team and operating model**
• Lead, coach and develop a distributed team of content producers and writers and
video specialists across London, Dubai and New York.
• Define clear roles, standards, workflows and decision rights so the team can move
quickly.
• Plan capacity and balance major strategic bets with the day-to-day needs of the
business.
• Build a modern, AI-enabled content operation that improves research, repurposing,
localisation and workflow efficiency while keeping human judgement and originality
at the centre.
• Manage specialist agencies, freelancers and production partners where external
expertise adds value.
**Distribution and commercial impact**
• Work closely with Brand, Social, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Regional
Marketing, Communications, SEO and Web to connect content with the full
customer journey.
• Ensure distribution is considered from the brief, with a clear audience, channel role
and intended action for every major asset.
• Use audience, engagement, search and commercial data to understand what is
working; stop low-value activity and invest further in formats that earn attention and
influence demand.
• Build a measurement framework that connects leading indicators such as reach,
returning audience and engagement quality with business outcomes including
product consideration, influenced pipeline and brand authority.
What success looks like
• Sokin has a clear and distinctive editorial point of view that its priority audiences
recognise.
• Flagship content earns attention outside Sokin’s existing network and becomes
useful to CFOs, treasurers and finance leaders.
• Senior leaders are known for credible, differentiated perspectives in the areas Sokin
wants to own.
• The team operates with clarity, speed and consistently high standards across
locations and formats.
• Content is demonstrably contributing to audience growth, product understanding,
brand authority and commercial demand.
• AI and smarter workflows increase the team’s leverage without producing generic or
low-quality work.
**Requirements**
• 10+ years of experience leading content in a fast-growing B2B technology, fintech,
financial services or similarly complex category.
• Evidence that you have built or significantly evolved a content operation, not only
inherited and maintained one.
• A strong portfolio of distinctive work across editorial, thought leadership, campaigns,
executive storytelling and video.
• Exceptional editorial judgement: you can find the sharp idea, simplify complexity,
improve a draft and recognise when work is not good enough.
• Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including people working
across different locations and time zones.
• Strong knowledge of content distribution, SEO and audience development, with the
ability to connect content choices to commercial outcomes.
• A practical understanding of how AI can improve the content system, paired with a
clear belief that technology does not replace taste, expertise or accountability.
• Comfort operating in a regulated environment where speed, accuracy and good judgement all matter

Working across all seven operating companies - Strata Create, Wonderland, Element, On Event Production Co., Trinity Event Solutions, Collider and Sherbet - together with the holding company and any entity operating outside the UK, the role will provide a clear, forward-looking view of cash, funding requirements and financial commitments to support confident commercial decision-making.
Our work is project-based, with costs, deposits, supplier prepayments, freelance crew, venue commitments and staged client billing often moving at different speeds, in different currencies, across seven businesses. Major productions can create material short-term movements in Group cash, so this role brings structure, consistency and insight to the cashflow view, ensuring treasury supports growth, operational discipline and informed decision-making.
The role reports to the Group CFO, works closely with the Group COO, and is the Group's single point of contact for banks, facility providers and our investors on all matters of liquidity, covenant and cash. It works collaboratively with finance leads in each operating company, sharing standards, systems and best practice. This is a build role - the model, the policy and the banking relationships are owned from day one.

*Cashflow Forecasting*
* Build and run a rolling 13-week direct cashflow forecast at Group and operating company level, refreshed weekly
* Own the medium-term view - 12-month (rolling) cashflow bridged to budget and forecast
* Forecast at project level for major productions, so cash exposure is visible before the Group commits, not after
* Track forecast accuracy, explain variances and improve the model each cycle
* Set the standard for operating company forecast submissions and challenge them where they do not hold up
*Liquidity & Banking*
* Manage day-to-day Group liquidity and headroom, with a known cash position across every account every morning
* Own bank and facility relationships, drawdowns and account structure
* Assess and implement cash pooling or sweeping where the entity structure allows
* Maintain and stress-test covenant headroom, and produce covenant compliance reporting to the required calendar
* Manage all investor interest payments (facility, loan note & other related)
* Own the payment run, authorisation matrix and banking controls across all entities
*Working Capital*
* Drive working capital performance across the Group: debtor days, creditor terms, WIP, unbilled revenue, deposit and staged-payment discipline
* Set and monitor working capital targets by operating company with the Group CFO and COO
* Work with commercial and finance leads to fix causes rather than chase symptoms - billing milestones that do not match delivery, contracts signed on terms we cannot fund, purchase orders raised without cash cover
* Support debtor escalation with evidence, working alongside account leads
*Risk, FX & Structure*
* Identify and manage foreign currency exposure on international projects and supplier commitments
* Recommend and execute a hedging policy that is proportionate rather than exotic
* Manage intercompany funding, balances and settlement, keeping positions clean and documented
* Own counterparty and payment fraud controls
* Work with the Group CFO and external advisers on the treasury implications of entity structure, including entities operating outside the UK
*Reporting & Governance*
* Produce the weekly cash report to the executive and the treasury pack for Board and investor reporting
* Draft, implement and maintain the Group treasury policy and delegated authority framework
* Support funding events, refinancing and transaction-related cash reporting
* Provide cash and funding input to acquisition activity and integration planning
*Systems & Continuous Improvement*
* Own the treasury toolset, assessing whether current systems are fit for a group of this scale and leading selection and implementation if they are not
* Automate the manual - consolidating seven spreadsheets by hand is not a long-term answer
* Define, document and maintain treasury processes and frameworks, scaling them as the business grows
*Collaboration Across Strata and the Group*
* Partner closely with operating company finance leads, Managing Directors and commercial teams
* Build treasury literacy across the Group so cash discipline is understood at brief stage, not at invoice stage
* Contribute to Group-wide procurement, banking and supplier consolidation initiatives

#### **About the Opportunity**
In this role, you will join MoonPay’s **Crypto Asset Management team** as a Product Manager, helping us build and scale the liquidity and asset infrastructure that supports products across MoonPay.
The team is responsible for how liquidity is sourced and distributed across our platform, supporting high-value crypto transaction volumes across multiple assets, venues, and blockchains. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it.
You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.
Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale.
Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.
#### **What You Will Do**
* **Own day-to-day product execution** across Crypto Asset Management initiatives, translating business, technical, operational, and compliance requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, and delivery milestones.
* **Support integrations with new liquidity sources**, including centralised exchanges, OTC trading desks, and decentralised services, helping expand MoonPay’s liquidity network and improve sourcing efficiency, reliability, and execution.
* **Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives** across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery.
* **Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure** across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions.
* **Support roadmap development and prioritisation**, using data, commercial value, operational requirements, customer impact, risk, and engineering constraints to help determine which initiatives should be addressed first.
* **Contribute to the evolution of our liquidity and asset-management infrastructure**, including custody and wallet capabilities, liquidity routing, best execution, settlement efficiency, monitoring, and risk-management tooling.
* **Use data to evaluate product performance and opportunities**, identifying friction, operational inefficiencies, or areas where product and infrastructure improvements can create measurable value for MoonPay and its customers.

The Retail Reconciliations Specialist will manage retail supplier statements, queries, escalations and not-on-account activity, while maintaining strong supplier relationships and supporting effective payment control. * Process and control hotel-only and ad-hoc payment requests in accordance with agreed finance procedures and approval requirements.
* Perform Retail VCC reconciliations, investigating variances and ensuring outstanding items are cleared promptly.
* Process retail cost amendments where relevant, ensuring changes are accurately supported, recorded and communicated.
* Manage IFH activity for International Sales in line with agreed processes and controls.
* Own the reconciliation and control of direct debit arrangements across global entities.
* Own end-to-end reconciliation of Payment Service Providers, ensuring transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately resolved.
* Monitor reconciliation performance, aged items and exception volumes, using data to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain clear Standard Operating Procedures and Work Instructions for key reconciliation processes and support knowledge sharing across the team.
* Build effective relationships with suppliers, Travel Counsellors and internal stakeholders while working within Travel Counsellors compliance requirements and CARE values.
